If CSR.MERRCTL.IsMERR=1, the hardware restores the value of the PWE field of CSR.MERRCTL to here; otherwise, if CSR.TLBRERA.IsTLBR=1, the hardware restores the value of the PWE field of CSR.TLBRPRMD to here; Otherwise, the hardware restores the value of the PWE field of CSR.PRMD here.
grades.reason: The CRMD field descriptions say ERTN restores WE, DATF and DATM. The source depends on the exception context: MERRCTL, TLBRPRMD or PRMD. This covers only some of the restored state, but it shows the selection logic.

grades.quote: when this bit is 1, * when ERTN returns, information used to restore the CSRs will come from PPLV, PLV and so on of this field; * when ERTN returns, address information will come from CSR.MERRERA.
grades.reason: For machine error exceptions, this passage says ERTN restores PLV and IE from MERRCTL's PPLV and PIE fields. It also says the return address comes from MERRERA. It covers only the machine-error case and only part of the state.
This is a table of contents fragment. It lists section titles and says nothing about what ERTN restores.

grades.quote: When IsMERR of this register is 1, the hardware restores the value of this field to the PG field of CSR.CRMD when the ERTN instruction is executed to return from the exception handler.
grades.reason: These MERRCTL fields say ERTN restores the saved WE, DA, PG, DATF and DATM values into CRMD when IsMERR is 1. That is a useful part of the restored state, limited to machine error exceptions.
